name: Louisiana
sources: Flat 3% rate, standard deduction indexed to CPI-U from 2026, personal and dependent exemptions repealed: Act 11 of 2024 Third Extraordinary Session; LDR Revenue Information Bulletin 25-012 (dam.ldr.la.gov/lawspolicies/RIB-25-012-Louisiana-Individual-Income-Tax-Reform-1.pdf)

2026 standard deduction $12,875 single/MFS, $25,750 MFJ/HoH/QSS: LDR RIB 26-005 Updated Withholding Tables (dam.ldr.la.gov/lawspolicies/RIB 26-005-Updated Withholding Tables.pdf); Form R-1210 (1/26) (dam.ldr.la.gov/taxforms/R-1210-1-26.pdf)
Computation starts from federal AGI, minus standard deduction, times 3%: 2025 IT-540 instructions, lines 7-11 (dam.ldr.la.gov/taxforms/IT540i-WEB-2025-Revised-7-26.pdf)
No rate change for 2026: 2026 Regular Session bills HB 253 and HB 411 deferred (houmatimes.com/?p=225408)
provisional: Standard deduction ($12,875 single/MFS, $25,750 MFJ/HoH) is LDR's estimate from CPI-U data available Dec 1, 2025; LDR says the final 2026 amount may differ slightly
